provenance.limitations: UNVERIFIED beyond automated cross-source checks. Each report is either 'corroborated' (2+ independent outlets, same city/outcome, within 3 days) or 'single_source' (one outlet only) -- shown explicitly. Extracted automatically from article text via keyword/dateline matching, not human-reviewed. Early news reports can be wrong about cause or severity. Never shows a name or exact age -- city, age BAND, device, and outcome only. Always check the linked source(s) before treating any single report as fact.
